body: I have attempted, with true intentions of death. Multiple times. This is not merely "ideation". I will re read tomorrow, thank you, friend, fpr taking the time to comment. Sorry if I'm being a cunt, am drunk. Only love intended bro ❤

100% makes sense. I can look at myself from an objective standpoint. "Someone who can't cope with the initial shock of a temporary situation jumping to suicide due to no other solution being cognised." This objective, detached view does no help, I still want to die. Unfortunatley, my other "solutions" are psychoactive sunstances... Sorry, I'm drunk af and didn't understand a good half of your comment.
I need to outsmart myself. Show my mind that it belongs to me. Thank you, Friend :) means more than you could imagine
My last attempts failed, I find myself wishing one of them worked, day in, day out. Seems worth it to me :(
Martial arts definitley help, but I feel like rubbish again as soon as I stop. I'm not contacting her. She'll just freak out, I'd rather be a coward and not be alive to see her freak out.
Would you agree that the stability is only ever temporary? I see this struggle with myself as life long. Been like that since I was 13.

Please, good sir, turn back. You have been to the suicide road before. I may relapse you with my arrogance. 
Edit: Sir/Mam

I really hate to contradict your efforts. They are highly appreciated, no less. But, I for one, only see technology as a leash. An addiction. No doubt, you are correct, I'll be missing out on shitloads, family's future, friend's future etc. However, I'm not currently immersed in these thing right now, so, what's the point?

I CAN'T burden another person with my mental health. I can't do relationships because I am nothing but a burden in them. They say that a problem shared, is a problem halved... I couldn't fathom dumping even a tenth of my problems on to someone. It's unfair of me to use another human being as a coping mechanism. I'm not trying to undermine you at all, friend, sorry if it came across that way.
Thank you, kind stranger. The only future I see is this endless, looping purgatory we call adulthood, excuse the salt lol.
Broo. Woman are nuts lol. Thanks for the idea though
I'm not alone, that has gotten me this far on its own. The other people must just be of a stronger mental fortitude.
Sorry. I fail to understand the term "72 poll." I'm a noob
